voice-branch-jargon.notes: The worst offender in this pass: the chapter is written as a branch-governance record. Body prose carries owner rulings with dates — "**Owner ruling (2026-07-12) — $\mathcal{M}$ = endomorphism ...**", "(terminology ruling **2026-07-06**, ...)", "## Photon $\gamma$ vs the unknot $0_1$ (**STRICT — recurring-mistake rule, 2026-08-01**)" — and an explicit work-plan block quoting the agent todo store and the PR: "> **Corpus migration — tracked follow-up.** The functional-sense $\mathcal{M}\to\mathfrak{m}$ rename touches ~14 further blocks (`brings-surface/`, `observations/`, `mass-theory/`) and must be done **per file** ... This authoritative ruling **lands now**; the mechanical-but-judged **sweep** is a **follow-up (bean, not this PR)** to keep the rename reviewable ...". Also "**Residual collision — follow-up cleanup:**", "raises a registered **audit flag**", "Where **the corpus** writes $\tau$ into a *different* target", a link out to "[AGENTS.md §7c](https://github.com/litlfred/qou/blob/main/AGENTS.md#7c-base-ring-convention...)", and three dated `docs/audits/2026-*` memos. Directory slugs, bean/PR vocabulary, rulings and dates are all branch state.
